RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.
As our Supply Chain & Logistics Planning Lead (m/f/d), you are the strategic and operational backbone of our global logistics and supply chain workflows. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it. You will streamline our end-to-end planning systems, bridge the gap between engineering changes and material availability, and ensure our modular hardware flows seamlessly from suppliers to customers.

Own supply chain planning end-to-end, translating demand into a robust Master Production Schedule (MPS) and a unified operating plan across all business units.
Design and evolve our logistics network , building efficient inbound, storage, and outbound processes while establishing robust US export readiness.
Develop and drive the inventory strategy across the entire organization to balance optimum material availability with working capital efficiency.
Lead the S&OP Lite process , aligning demand, capacity, and supply into a single operating plan and preparing critical trade-off scenarios when supply constraints exist.
Facilitate weekly S&OE Reviews to actively resolve delivery exceptions, track open PO status, and manage ERP system alerts.
Own the Engineering Change Control process from a supply chain perspective, ensuring BOM or specification changes are fully assessed and managed after handoff.
Manage and optimize ERP system planning as the core operational backbone of all planning and logistics workflows.
Act as the senior point of contact for Category Managers, the Delivery Office, and business unit leads on all key planning and logistics matters.

About RobCo
Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.
We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics.

With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.
